concept-a-isometric-triad.prompt:
Create a full-screen landscape iPad game screenshot showing the Creature Lab selection moment. Show only the game viewport: no tablet hardware, bezel, hands, fingers, person, desk, marketing frame, captions, callouts, or presentation background. Keep the important composition safe inside a centered 4:3 landscape crop. Match the supplied premium 2D storybook assets: dark-plum hand-inked outlines, layered flat colors, cel shadows, tiny gouache texture, jewel-toned purple, teal, orange, and mint. This must feel like a modern diegetic console-game minigame where the room itself is the interface, not a classic mobile app. No horizontal tile rows, floating white cards, modal picker panels, standard form controls, inventory grid, or large text labels.

The player is choosing three obvious contributing dimensions. Make their purpose unmistakable through physical design: a CREATURE device previews body/form choices, an OUTFIT device previews a complete mannequin/look, and a BUDDY device previews companion choices. Each device shows one large current selection and small previous/next choices physically peeking through its mechanism, telegraphing that a swipe or dial motion changes the option. The three chosen contributions feed visibly into one central creature reactor. Include one dormant embellishment socket and one satisfying physical lever, but do not show a finished character yet. Use cat, astronaut suit, and fox as the currently selected examples. No readable words, logos, gibberish typography, timers, score, currency, or tutorial arrows.

CONCEPT A — ISOMETRIC TRIAD LAB. Fixed three-quarter isometric camera looking inward into a cozy tall workshop. Arrange three large purpose-built machines as a triangle around a bright central glass reactor: left is a bubbling creature specimen vat with cat form centered and bunny/dragon silhouettes peeking in adjacent tubes; right is a wardrobe press with a full astronaut mannequin centered and neighboring costumes visible on a rotating drum; foreground is a playful orbital buddy beacon with fox centered and owl/puppy medallions circling behind it. Copper pipes visibly connect all three to the reactor. Deep spatial layering, foreground machinery, no empty showroom feel.
